title: Optimize trigram LIKE bitmap intersection
rationale: Trigram wildcard LIKE search intersected postings in trigram order and row key mapping grew from an empty Vec. Starting from the smallest bitmap reduces intersection work, and preallocating output capacity avoids repeated Vec growth while mapping candidate row ids.
steps: Return empty bitmap immediately when a trigram is missing or has no postings
Sort postings by bitmap cardinality and intersect smallest first
Preallocate row key mapping output based on result cardinality
Add direct trigram unit tests and verify LIKE integration behavior
expected_impact: Reduces bitmap intersection work for multi-trigram wildcard LIKE queries and lowers allocation churn when mapping candidate ids to row keys.
